features.feature: two envelopes (Team, the lift role) with ballonet bands, gore seams, nose battens, ridge Team bands
cruciform X tail fins with rudders on each envelope, nav lights
ridge walkways with rails, vents, mooring points, the left envelope's solar arrays, the right one's observation blister, antenna farm and dish
the armoured spine deck with its truss into the envelopes, deck lines, railings, lockers, fittings, crates, hatches, beacon, flag
two dual-purpose turrets on barbettes: the 57 mm house and the twin 30 mm beside it, one muzzle a barrel
the radar mast and platform, the spinning array with grid and IFF bar
the keel gondola (Hull) with the bridge window band and command windows, the Team band, portholes, floodlights
weak point: the bomb bay doors on hinge pivots (a later bomb-run pass opens them), riveted and one shade off, over the racked bombs
the two drone hangars with doors, rails, cradles, drones and their launch doors
the 105 mm ball pods on struts under the envelopes
weak point: four engine nacelles on pylons, riveted and one shade off, with grilles, exhausts and four-blade propellers
